lines: 「Not a single one of you was a worthy opponent, hmm? Even though I thought you'd do a little better, since you're dressed up like that...」
The group of soldiers who had marched into the restaurant had been somewhat better-armed than the men from before, but they were still no match for Astaroth.
The men, who appeared to have been saved, bowed even more deeply.
「I've no cause to be thanked, especially. I'm going to burn you too now, after all.」
Hellfire lit up in Astaroth's hand. The men shrieked, 「Hiiih!」 and curled up on the floor.
「If Astaroth-san gets serious, the restaurant's gonna be blown apart! Our cash cow!!」
The ones who had stopped her were Lilim and Minasaki. Astaroth gazed at the pair of them like they were getting in her way, but suddenly put out her fire.
「Dear me, the buildings of the human world certainly are fragile......」
The men let out sighs of relief.
「Why don't you old guys head home too? And make sure you pay damages for how badly you hurt our business!!」
Ignoring Minasaki and Lilim, who were shooing them away, the men called out to Astaroth, behind them.
「How persistent you are. Do you wish to get burned that badly?」
「That's not it! We wanna destroy Yomihara!!」
「We're brothers, originally born in Hell...... Right, Aniki?」
「Yeah, Otouto. But the environment there was too harsh for us low-level demons.」
Strangely enough, they too had the ability to wield fire, but their fire powers were on the level of a gas burner, at best.
Knowing that they couldn't survive in the Demon World, where the strong preyed upon the weak, they had fled to the human realm, and become members of the  “armed refugees” that infested Yomihara.
At some point, the people who flooded into cities of darkness and wandered around, armed, had come to be referred to as that.
Their makeup was varied, with both refugees from Hell, and humans who no longer had anywhere to go, even in the criminal underworld.
They were all individuals with “special circumstances”, who drifted in because they could no longer stay in the places where they were――
「They seem to be in every city of darkness, but the armed refugees here in Yomihara are especially famous.」
It was said that the armed refugees had been extensively involved in the construction of Yomihara, under Nomad's directions.
Perhaps because of that, Yomihara's armed refugees had better connections than the ones in other cities, as well as a certain amount of influence.
「Even if they call us armed refugees, in the end, it's still the criminal underworld. It's a world where the strong prey on the weak.」
「And we're weak. We're the bottom rung, by nature. Our lives are like night and day, compared to the leader guys.」
The men explained, with a self-deprecating air.
「Despite taking on cheap work and getting tricked many times, we three brothers still combined our strength to make it where we are.」
Lilim cocked her head in confusion. There were only two people in front of her eyes.
「You're going to say, “There are only two of you,” right? There was another one, a brother younger than me. But, he......」
The younger brother cast his eyes downwards regretfully.
The youngest brother had been deceived by the boss who controlled their group of armed refugees, and had gotten sold to Nomad as a guinea pig for demonic experiments.
「We hurried to go and rescue him. But sadly, we're weak.」
「We got beaten to a pulp by the security guys, and though we managed to get away, we ended up with targets on our heads instead.」
「After that, we learned that our little brother was subjected to cruel experiments, and summarily killed......」
「We can't go back to the armed refugees, neither, not after defying the boss. And we wound up being hounded by Nomad, too...... We're done for...... Completely done for now.」
「Sooner or later, we're gonna be killed by our pursuers from Nomad, or the refugee boss's henchmen.」
「But we can't afford to just die for nothing like this! Figuring that, we decided that for our last stand, we're gonna destroy Yomihara!」
「That's the only revenge available to us......」
The two of them finished their tale, and sat down dejectedly.
「Destroying Yomihara, that's sure setting your sights high.」
Nomad had created the underground city of Yomihara through the might of the armed refugees.
And both parties were reaping huge benefits from it.
The brothers figured that destroying Yomihara would serve as revenge against them, both in principle and in terms of actual results.
「I understand what you want to do, but it's silly to rely on other people's strength. Why don't you have a go at it yourselves?」
「We did have a go! We went all do-or-die, and tried blowing up a brothel Nomad owns.」
「But sadly, as you can see, we're weak...... We failed miserably, and wound up being chased.」
「And that's why you tried to hide in our store? A fine nuisance you've been. Seriously!」
「So those soldiers from before were those pursuers, then?」
Like with the saying, “If you want to hide a tree, do it in a forest,” the brothers had barged into this restaurant, which was the most noticeably crowded in the back street.
「We can't escape from Nomad under our own power. But, if we had Onee-san's strength...... far from escape, we could even turn the tables!」
「What's this now? You're completely dependent on others, aren't you? There's no benefit to me whatsoever.」
「Please, we're beggin' you! We can give you everything we own!」
The siblings bowed their heads, holding out the food and precious stones they had on them.
These were all their possessions. The armed refugees, who didn't even have a dwelling, were carrying everything they owned like this.
Not even looking at that, Astaroth made a shooing motion with her hand.
「We'll have no choice but to do it ourselves after all, Aniki.」
「But there's no tellin' when that strong guy'll pop out again......」
She reacted to the words of the siblings, who were about to give up and head back.
「Hold on. There's a strong guy, you say?」
「No, no, surely not, no way! ......is what I'd like to say, but I dunno. 'Cuz he's really strong against fire, y'see.」
The older brother scolded, but Astaroth seemed delighted.
「A big, ridiculously powerful man――Well, probably a man.」
She chuckled to herself in apparent satisfaction.
A strong man――That was precisely what she was searching for.
「I see. I don't mind giving you a hand♪ As long as I get to meet that strong guy.」
Paying no attention to the brothers, who ran up to her with tears in their eyes, Astaroth turned back to Lilim and Minasaki.
「Lilim, Minasaki, it was just like you said. That I would be able to meet a strong man if I stayed here.」
「If nothing happened after a little while longer, I was planning on burning you alive for the crime of deceiving me, though♪」
「Hiiih! I'm saved...... Uh, right! That's great, Astaroth-san!!」
The pair of critters made stiff smiles, and waved their hands at her.
Urging on the brothers, who were shaken by the abruptness of her change in attitude, Astaroth promptly set off outside.
When they came out, rain was falling.
It often rained in Yomihara. Rain from the earth's surface would travel through the ground over many years, and drip down as subterranean water.
「So, where is this strong guy you speak of?」
「But he always shows up when he gets wind of a fire.」
「Oh, really?♪ Then I'll be able to meet him easily. Shall I start a fire right away?」
Astaroth held a hand out and summoned her Hellfire, but the brothers hurriedly stopped her.
「No, no, not here! There's all this rain, after all!」
「Oh, this little is no problem at all. I just have to make it evaporate.」
「There's a much better, more suitable place for Astaroth-san to burn!」
While the three of them were loudly arguing in the rain――
What came rushing out was a woman carrying a long sword, accompanied by soldiers.
「I am Lena, Knight of Nomad! A member of the Knight Corps, who train hard every day under Ingrid-sama!」
Lena smugly gave her name, then pointed at the two behind Astaroth.
「Onee-san's an unfamiliar face, but those two are the terrorists who tried to blow up that building, aren't they?!」
「Geh, a Hell Knight?! We've been found by some real trouble.」
For them to be caught already, in a place like this, right after leaving the restaurant...
「We were tipped off by some ordinary, righteous citizens who care about the public order of Yomihara! ...Ah! I'll have to get them their reward money...」
People who would know about and report the pair's crime, their future actions, and their whereabouts――
Only two people came to mind, but they decided to put that aside for now.
「Terrorists who disrupt the peace of Yomihara! Turn to dust from Sakura Blossom!」
